description: Search publications in the Federal Gazette (Bundesblatt BBl / Feuille fédérale FF / Foglio federale FF): Federal Council dispatches (Botschaften) on new bills, draft federal acts and decrees, referendum texts, reports and official notices. Filter by title keyword and publication-date range; returns date, title, BBl reference (e.g. 'BBl 2024 1234') and Fedlex link, newest first. Examples: {query:'Botschaft'}; {query:'Klima', date_from:'2023-01-01'}; {query:'énergie', language:'fr'}.

date_from.description: Earliest publication date (default: 90 days before date_to, or 2 years with a query; range max 2 years)

query.description: Title keyword in the chosen language, e.g. 'Botschaft', 'Datenschutz'

name: search_federal_gazette
title: Search the Federal Gazette (BBl)
